notes: Encoded ONLY from Hydro-Temp's own page. Page states an 8-character serial: 5 letters followed by 2 numeric digits (year of manufacture) and ending with a single letter. No month or week is stated in text, so this style ships year-only. The page's ANSI/CSA standards section is a generic manufacture-date estimation method, not a serial rule, and is NOT encoded. No era dates are documented on the page, so the default yearFloor 1960 applies.

styles.era: 8-character serials, 5 letters + 2 year digits + 1 letter, year only
styles.notes: Page positions: the 2 numeric digits (normalized positions [5,7]) are the year of manufacture. Page example OEBDG96A decodes to 1996.
